notes: The booklet has two models: the yellow Racer X car (bag 1, b1-b107) and the red Taejo Togokhan car (bag 2, b109-b228). The sticker sheet is b108 and is shared.
The two minifigures (helmets, heads, torsos, legs, visor) are not in the official parts list, so they are not nodes.

The booklet's pictures are small, so the split of pieces between the two cars is inferred from the page-31 and page-32 piece pictures plus the steps. Exact stud-to-stud positions and some piece identities in the steps (for example which black or grey plates sit where) are best-effort. Ports are mostly left null.

Both cars use the same wheel assembly. An axle goes through the Technic brick pin holes, with a wheel and tyre at each end and a bush on the axle. Two wheel covers per car are put on two of the four wheels. Which wheels carry the covers is assumed.
Stickers are modelled as one node with 'joined' (sticker, damaging) edges to a few representative parts, not every sticker location.
